notes: Disagreements (2 of 40, both the same wrong Sorani term): rows 208 ("Excellent durability Ideal for high-end customization, elegant crafts") and 220 ("Natural Wood Grain for Versatile Crafting") gave "crafts/crafting" as «دەستکاریی». In this app «دەستکاری» is the UI word for "Edit" (src: edit: 'دەستکاری', editProfile, editOffer …) and in Sorani it means modifying or tampering, so «دەستکاریی جوان» reads as "nice editing". Batches 012, 029, 032 and 035 use «کاری دەستی» for crafts. Fixed to «کاری دەستیی جوان» and «کاری دەستیی جۆراوجۆر».

The same defect sat in three rows outside the sample, and they were fixed the same way: 200 ("Delicate crafts, puzzles, children's DIY, painting projects"), 203 ("Home decor, office supplies, delicate crafts") and 243 (Bambu Basswood Plywood description, «دروستکردنی کاری دەستیی ناسک»). After the fix no ckb slot in out/028.json contains «دەستکاری». Only the ckb field of those 5 rows changed; every other byte of the file is unchanged (same indent=1 serialization). Validator: packages/catalog/src/bambuImport/i18n.ts validateTranslationRow (levonis-i18n worktree) with names.json and IDENTITY, run through rev018/val.mts. All 245 rows of out/028.json pass, before and after the fix, and so do my 40 independent rows. The file has no keep and no needs_review rows.

Row 6 ("connects the extruder and the component cooling fan interface"): the first translation reads "component cooling fan" as the part cooling fan («مروحة تبريد القطعة المطبوعة» / «پانکەی ساردکردنەوەی پارچەی چاپکراو»). This is the fan the P2S extruder connection board serves, and "component" is Bambu's wording for "part", so it is an interpretation and not a wrong fact. My literal «مروحة تبريد المكوّنات» was looser. No change.

Rows 12, 18, 24, 79, 91, 128, 140 and 183: the first translation glosses part names in Arabic/Sorani and adds the English name in brackets, e.g. «مروحة التبريد المساعدة اليسرى (Auxiliary Part Cooling Fan)». I used a head noun plus the Latin name, e.g. «مروحة Auxiliary Part Cooling Fan (Left)». Both keep every protected name verbatim (the validator checks this), so the difference is style. Row 18 says «لوحة MC Board» (board twice). That is redundant but correct.

All other differences are style only. Examples: «الكابلان الأسودان» vs «كابلا التوصيل الأسودان» (row 0); «قياس» vs «رصد» for "detect" (row 67); «هادئ» vs «ناعم» for "soft" wood colour (row 202); Sorani «لابە» vs «لاببە» (row 177); «کرتە بکە» vs «کلیک بکە» for "click" (row 232). The app already uses «کرتە».

Limitation and warning rows outside the sample were read for dropped facts: 2, 31, 35, 69, 92, 96, 97, 103, 117, 123, 124, 126, 127, 129, 158, 181, 194, 223, 230, 231, 239 and 240. Every "except the heatbed", "only", "do not reuse", "replacement part only and does not improve resolution", "when not in use", "not more than 0.5 mg/L" and "refer to Wiki" is kept in both languages. Every number and unit survives (100–240 V, 24 V, 100-240V, 24V, 12W, 0.5 mg/L, USB 2.0).
